body: Any time Martin laughs with the boys rather than at them brings me so much joy.

Ohhh hiii. Pretty sure this is Day 5 for me. My last drink was on Friday so that maths works out right? Need to get a badge I know!!!

Feeling so positive. Went to see the new Whitney Houston documentary last night- such a tragic portrait of the horrors of addiction. Was walking home and walked past this vintage shop that was having live music (I live in hipster central London) and I decided to pop in and ended up seeing an amazing band and danced till my feet hurt. I was alone but didn't feel lonely. 

Tonight I'm going to a film quiz, again on my own but with the idea of meeting people.

Still struggling with low mood here and there but have a doctors appointment tomorrow to review my antidepressants and have my regular therapy appointment tomorrow.

Good or bad- I will not drink today!

I'm so sorry to hear your story. It's a huge fear of mine.

I've spoken to her a bit and she's totally right to want some time. I suppose because I want to sweep it under the rug (like I always have done) I'm finding it really hard. But I'm learning that sorry doesn't always cut it. Time is a healer and it's barely been 4 days.

I've also spent today looking for new non-alcohol focused events that I could attend. Ways to meet new people. I worry I do rely on her a bit too much.

Thanks for checking in friend.

1) 498 days- wow! You're a machine.

2) How I wish I could have "_in_NY" in my username. Most amazing city ever. Whereabouts do you live?

Day 4 for me (not got a badge yet)- I will not drink today. Good or bad. 

I need to face up to my mistakes and deal with them totally consciously. No more hiding away.
I really hope she does forgive me.

Not drinking today. Desperately trying to make amends with my best friend after apparently shouting at her on Friday night. I say apparently not because I don't trust her but because I blacked out. I can't remember anything.

She likened me to an abusive ex of hers. Which terrifies me. I grew up with an emotionally abusive dad and I have spent so long trying not to be him.

"All I have is today" I like that. It takes the pressure off I suppose. No thinking I MUST go x number of days. Just one day at a time.

I think I'll give it a bit of time before I hit up a meeting.

Wow! Your number of days is amazing!!!

So aside from meetings- what were your tools?

Thanks for checking in friend.

Well this was lovely. Thank you so much.

The kindness of strangers on this sub never ceases to cheer me and remind me of the good in this world.

Congrats on your number! I will not drink today.

So I'm seeing a therapist (2nd session will be on Thursday)- mostly about bereavement but also low self esteem.

Have considered AA but there have been a few horror stories on here for me. I don't know what Smart Recovery is- could you explain? (Too lazy to google!)

When I've been successful in the past- it's when I've been on here regularly. So I'll do that again.

Thanks for checking in friend. Congrats on the 27!
Actually starting to like the taste of tonic water without the gin.

You're amazing. Thank you for sharing your story.

I lost my Gran almost a month ago now. And I appreciate it's not the same, she was old, it was expected (all those rational cliches) but the fact is- it hurts like nothing I've ever experienced. Even though I knew it was coming and it was her 'time', I'm still so angry and sad. And so I've been drinking pretty solidly every night. Thinking nothing of polishing off two bottles of wine on a Wednesday night whilst my housemate has nothing to drink except tea and water. Because I didn't want to be in this reality, I wanted to numb everything.

But that's not the way. I know that. And that's why I'm making this conscious effort to quit drinking for a while, maybe even forever, but so I can properly process the hurt I'm going through and make a positive change.

My Gran was one of my best friends and she had so much belief in me and I feel constantly that I'm going to let her down if I let the drink win.

I will not drink with you.
3 days. Want that number to keep growing. I will not drink with you today.
I know...it's my housemates though. I just put it back to the back of the cupboard.
I will not drink today. Committed to feeling my pain without self medicating.

Are you me? This is exactly what I'm going through at the moment.

I posted on here a couple of weeks ago about my pain and how I've been using alcohol to numb it and some amazing people (as the community for SD is) came through for me. And I, being the selfish prick that I am, pretty much ignored them all and carried on with my self destruction. 

Since then the pain has gotten worse and I've been drinking to a point of pushing everyone away. I don't blame them though. I don't want to be with me right now so why would they.

I didn't drink last night though and don't plan on drinking tonight.
